description: This file contains shell script code for testing the 'update-index --refresh' functionality in Git, specifically related to handling racy timestamps. It includes functions for setting up test files, asserting index timestamp changes, and multiple test cases to validate correct behavior.

methods.name: reset_files
methods.description: Resets test files 'file' and 'other' by writing content and setting their modification times.

methods.name: update_assert_changed
methods.description: Sets the magic timestamp of '.git/index' to a past time, runs 'git update-index' with optional flags, and asserts that the index's mtime has changed.
